return.message: Use the KOT billing workspace for offline setup.

actions.script: workspace=exported.workspace def terminal=billing.terminal def orgId=terminal.organizationPartyId def aliases=ec.entity.find('zenith.erp.barcode.ProductBarcode').condition([organizationPartyId:orgId,isActive:'Y']) .list().groupBy { it.productId } def categories=ec.entity.find('mantle.product.category.ProductCategory').condition('ownerPartyId',orgId) .selectField('productCategoryId').list()*.productCategoryId def memberships=categories ? ec.entity.find('mantle.product.category.ProductCategoryMember') .condition('productCategoryId','in',categories).conditionDate('fromDate','thruDate',ec.user.nowTimestamp) .list().groupBy { it.productId } : [:] def standardMode=!workspace.modes if (standardMode) workspace.modes=[[id:'',name:'Standard',inclusive:false]] workspace.products=workspace.products.collect { product -> product + [aliases:(aliases[product.productId] ?: [])*.barcodeValue, categoryIds:(memberships[product.productId] ?: [])*.productCategoryId, prices:standardMode ? [ (''):[price:product.listPrice,disc:0,blocked:false] ] : product.prices] } def template=ec.service.sync().name('zenith.pos.ReceiptTemplateServices.resolve#TerminalPrintTemplate') .parameter('terminalId',terminal.terminalId).call().template if (template) { workspace.store += [name:template.companyName ?: workspace.store.name, address:[template.addressLine1,template.addressLine2,template.city,template.state,template.pincode].findAll { it }.join(', '), phone:template.phone ?: workspace.store.phone,receiptWidth:template.receiptWidth ?: '80mm'] } workspace.sessionId=sessionId workspace.facilityId=terminal.facilityId workspace.remove('discountLimit')

return.message: Sync offline orders from the KOT billing workspace.
